en: Jātaka: The Second Book of Birth Stories (Dukanipāta), Chapter on the Yellow Robe (Kāsāvavagga)
8. The Kāmanīta Jātaka “Three kingdoms I desire within my mountain range:
O Brahmin, treat me who am bitten by desire.
“Some perform [rites] for one bitten by a black snake,” he said.
The wise provide treatment for one who has been possessed by a non-human spirit;
but no one provides treatment for one led away by sensual desire—
for what medical cure can there be for one who has fallen into impurity?
